_readme: The batch driver's source of truth. status: pending|authoring|passed|failed.
Each game needs a matching stub pack_<id>.js (structure + 18-figure roster).
Create stubs by adding a game struct to ../generate_more.js (same shape as the
5 there) and running `node generate_more.js` ONCE. Then add a line here and run
batch_driver.py. To reach 50: extend generate_more.js to 50 structs, mirror the
ids here. The 5 STEM stubs already authored (marine/dam/rail/rocket/reactor) are
listed as 'passed' so the driver skips them; the 5 non-STEM below are examples
you must add structs+stubs for before running.
mystery fields drive the author prompt: overclaim(sensational wrong),
dismissal(do-nothing wrong), truth(concealed systemic), guilty_who + true_where
must be the truth ids in that pack's CATS.
